changeControl.rule: Any change to scenarios, seeds, endpoints, margins, hypotheses, exclusions, weights, timing, or pass rules requires a new protocol version before examining candidate results.
changeControl.erratumRule: A non-substantive correction must preserve the original file, identify the corrected fields, and state why no result or decision can change.
changeControl.reason: Protocol v1 was frozen before execution but contained contradictory native-reference and worker-count rules and an unobservable cross-tool estimation-stage timing boundary. No candidate or comparator result was run. Version 2 resolves those design defects without changing workloads, seeds, practical margins, sample sizes, hypotheses, or pass logic.

claim.scope: Rigid within-run three-dimensional fMRI motion estimation and correction on the registered protocol-v2 workloads.
claim.acceptedLanguage: On the preregistered reframe4s motion-superiority-v2 workloads and hardware, reframe4s-motion was both faster and more accurate than AFNI 3dvolreg and nifreeze by the prespecified practical margins; FSL MCFLIRT results are reported as a required context comparison.
claim.unmetLanguage: reframe4s-motion did not demonstrate the preregistered joint speed-and-accuracy superiority claim against both AFNI 3dvolreg and nifreeze on motion-superiority-v2.
forbiddenLanguage: superior to FSL MCFLIRT unless its four contextual superiority hypotheses also pass
superior when any required court, comparator, endpoint, or scenario is missing

blockers.reason: The candidate must be a clean immutable git revision with published artifact checksums.
Resolve and record the linux/amd64 manifest digest for the versioned AFNI image.
Build the pinned nifreeze commit from a fully hashed dependency lock and record the image digest.
Install the pinned FSL manifest under an accepted non-commercial license and record package hashes and mcflirt version output.
Freeze the public real-anatomy dataset manifest, including at least twelve eligible subjects, checksums, provenance, and redistribution constraints, before any candidate result is run.
Record the benchmark host, operating system, firmware, CPU governor, thermal policy, JVM, Node, filesystem, and available memory.

Confirm each implementation's registered effective worker count at both allocated-core settings from implementation contracts, tool configuration, or a locked runtime probe; an environment variable alone is not evidence of parallel execution.

admission.rule: The structural validator may pass while admission is blocked. The claim validator must fail unless every blocker is removed by a signed environment-and-data lock and all required receipt hashes are present.

implementations.license: AFNI distribution terms recorded with the locked image
Apache-2.0 for nifreeze; all transitive and ANTs licenses must be recorded in the environment lock

configuration.effectiveWorkerEvidence: locked ANTs num_threads configuration and runtime probe required

implementations.license: FSL non-commercial license; the runner may not redistribute FSL binaries

data.clusterRule: Frames, voxels, landmarks, repetitions, and scenarios are repeated measurements within subject and are never independent sampling units.

realAnatomySubjects.role: required external-validity guardrail; these subjects are not pooled with analytic synthetic subjects for the headline co-primary estimates
realAnatomySubjects.selectionRule: Use the first twelve eligible subject-run identifiers in bytewise lexical order from the frozen public dataset manifest. Eligibility is decided from metadata and file integrity before any implementation is run.
realAnatomySubjects.injectionRule: Select the registered motion-free reference volume, reconstruct it on a 0.75 mm isotropic world grid with a benchmark-only windowed-sinc implementation, apply the four registered SE3 trajectories, and integrate onto the native complete affine. The injector may not call any candidate or comparator resampler.
realAnatomySubjects.analysisRule: Report the real-anatomy stratum separately. Every headline comparator-by-metric contrast must pass the registered scenario non-inferiority margin, and candidate failure and absolute gates must pass. These results may veto but may not rescue the synthetic headline superiority decision.

exploratoryInputsExcludedFromClaims.provenance: not recorded in the source checkout
not recorded in the source checkout

scenarioGeneration.poseRule: For each of six fixed-frame twist components, sum every registered harmonic amplitude*sin(2*pi*frequency*u+phase), add registered impulses, subtract the value at frame zero, and form movingToFixed with the exact SE3 exponential.
scenarioGeneration.noiseRule: Use a counter-based PRNG keyed by subjectSeed, scenarioSeed, frame, voxel index, and nuisance stream name so execution order cannot change generated values.

commonCourt.rule: Every estimator receives frame zero as the fixed target. No estimator receives the scoring mask; the immutable registered mask is used only by the independent scorer.

nativeCourt.rule: Each implementation uses the prospectively registered production reference policy below. Differences are part of the native pipeline and must remain visible in every run record and interpretation.

scenarioGeneration.maskPolicy: Render the motion-free continuous field on the target grid, threshold at 15 intensity units, and use that immutable mask for every implementation and score.

courts.purpose: Measure transform estimation without credit or blame for each implementation's output interpolation.
courts.inputs: Identical NIfTI values, complete affine, and frame-zero fixed target. The registered mask is supplied only to the independent scorer.
courts.outputs: One movingToFixed physical 4-by-4 matrix per frame plus typed or normalized failure status.
courts.scoring: Convert every output through a separately tested adapter, score pose and landmarks directly, and apply every accepted pose with one independent benchmark resampler for corrected-image metrics.
courts.timing: Common-court elapsed time begins immediately before fresh process or already-provisioned container launch and ends after every canonical physical pose matrix is materialized and fsynced. Corrected-image application and common scoring resampling are excluded. Tool-internal stage splits are diagnostic only.

courts.purpose: Measure the complete recommended correction pipeline, including native interpolation.
courts.inputs: Identical local NIfTI input, complete affine, allocated-core ceiling, and output filesystem. Each method uses its prospectively registered native reference and mask policy.
courts.outputs: Corrected NIfTI, physical matrices, stage timing, stdout, stderr, exit status, peak RSS, and checksums.
courts.scoring: Score native corrected images and converted physical transforms; retain each implementation's boundary and interpolation behavior.
courts.timing: Elapsed time begins immediately before process or already-provisioned container launch and ends after corrected image and transform files are fsynced. Dataset download, environment construction, and image pull are excluded.

workerCountSemantics.allocatedCoreCount: The maximum isolated physical cores made available to the process or container.
workerCountSemantics.requestedWorkerCount: The maximum algorithm workers requested through the method's supported configuration and environment.
workerCountSemantics.effectiveWorkerCount: The maximum algorithm workers the registered implementation can actually use under that configuration. It is not the operating-system thread count.
workerCountSemantics.rule: Every run records all three counts and evidence source. effectiveWorkerCount must be positive and no greater than requestedWorkerCount, which must be no greater than allocatedCoreCount. The four-core court permits methods to exploit up to four cores; it does not relabel a serial implementation as four-threaded. The one-core sensitivity court requires all three counts to equal one.

execution.cpuAffinity: All methods use the same isolated four physical cores. Simultaneous multithreading siblings are excluded.
execution.frequencyPolicy: Use one fixed performance governor or record a fixed-frequency host. Abort on thermal throttling or governor changes.
execution.memoryPolicy: No swapping, no competing workload, and at least twice the maximum observed peak RSS available.
execution.filesystemPolicy: Inputs and outputs use the same local filesystem. Each measured repetition writes to a new directory. Page-cache policy is identical across methods and recorded.

randomization.methodOrder: balanced Latin square with a seeded permutation per block
randomization.rule: All required methods complete one repetition in a block before the next repetition begins.

stageBoundaries.decode: open input through validated in-memory sampled values
stageBoundaries.prepare: construct masks, templates, grids, compiled stencils, and immutable plans
stageBoundaries.estimate: optional method-internal first optimizer preparation through final native physical pose matrix; diagnostic because equivalent boundaries are not externally observable for every comparator
stageBoundaries.apply: first output sample through materialized corrected values
stageBoundaries.encode: begin output serialization through fsync and close
stageBoundaries.endToEnd: fresh process or container launch through all required fsynced outputs

metrics.aggregation: Within subject and scenario, compute the p95 over frames and the fixed registered landmark set; combine scenarios with registered equal weights.
metrics.missingValuePolicy: A missing or non-finite value is a method failure and is not omitted.

metrics.aggregation: Root masked squared error over all non-reference frames divided by the masked motion-free truth standard deviation, first within subject and scenario, then equal-weighted across scenarios.
metrics.missingValuePolicy: A missing or non-finite value is a method failure and is not omitted.

metrics.aggregation: Median of twenty measured repetitions within subject, scenario, and method; equal-weighted log ratios across scenarios.
metrics.missingValuePolicy: A failed or missing repetition is a method failure; fewer than twenty measurements makes the whole court inadmissible.

metrics.aggregation: Median of twenty measured common-court process-boundary repetitions within subject, scenario, and method; equal-weighted log ratios across scenarios.
metrics.missingValuePolicy: A failed or missing repetition is a method failure; fewer than twenty measurements makes the whole court inadmissible.

metrics.aggregation: p95 over frames within subject and scenario
p95 absolute error in relative-pose framewise displacement over frame transitions within subject and scenario
NRMSE within the registered three-voxel inner boundary shell, within subject and scenario
Masked NRMSE of first temporal differences against motion-free truth within subject and scenario
Absolute log ratio of masked physical-gradient energy to motion-free truth, within subject and scenario
Fraction outside the local truth envelope expanded by one percent of global truth range, within subject and scenario
Required runs with nonzero exit, typed non-success termination, missing outputs, non-finite values, or checksum failure divided by all required runs
p95 measured peak RSS within subject, scenario, court, and method

headlineFamily.null: The registered paired effect is less than or equal to the metric's positive practical superiority margin.
headlineFamily.alternative: The registered paired effect is greater than the metric's positive practical superiority margin.

contextFamily.rule: Test and report the same superiority hypotheses separately. They do not alter the headline AFNI-and-nifreeze claim and cannot replace a failed headline comparison.

scenarioGuardrails.rule: For every scenario, the lower simultaneous confidence bound for each co-primary paired effect must be greater than the negative scenario non-inferiority margin.

statistics.analysisSet: The headline superiority estimates use the twenty-four analytic synthetic subjects. The twelve or more real-anatomy subjects form a separate required external-validity stratum that may veto but not rescue the headline decision. Every required run follows intention-to-benchmark and failures remain failures.
statistics.scenarioWeights: Use the four registered 0.25 weights. Do not weight by voxels, frames, landmarks, or runtime repetitions.
statistics.intervalMethod: Studentized paired cluster bootstrap with 10000 subject resamples and deterministic seed 7301.
statistics.headlineMultiplicity: For the eight headline hypotheses, use one-sided 99.375 percent bootstrap lower confidence bounds and Holm-adjusted one-sided paired sign-flip p-values controlling family-wise error at 0.05.
statistics.contextMultiplicity: Use Holm control at family-wise 0.05 across the four FSL MCFLIRT context hypotheses and label the family contextual.
statistics.guardrailMultiplicity: Use Bonferroni one-sided 95 percent family-wise lower bounds within each metric across the eight headline comparator-by-scenario contrasts.
statistics.precisionRule: The fixed sample is twenty-four synthetic subjects plus at least twelve locked real-anatomy subjects. There is no result-dependent early stop or sample-size extension.
exclusions: A subject may be excluded only for a pre-run checksum mismatch, corrupt source file, or preregistered metadata ineligibility.
A method crash, timeout, invalid transform, missing frame, non-finite metric, or output checksum failure is not an exclusion.
A host-control failure invalidates the whole randomized block for every method; rerun the complete block and retain the invalid receipt.

absoluteGates: The candidate satisfies every non-null candidateAbsoluteGate in every required scenario.
Every implementation has a failure_rate at or below 0.02; an unavailable required comparator makes the court inadmissible.
Every transform adapter passes independent polarity, full-affine, identity, and landmark tests before benchmark execution.
Every output has the expected frame count, complete affine, finite values, and registered checksums.
completePassRule: Claim admission is true and every environment, data, candidate, and comparator lock is resolved.
Both required courts complete for all registered subjects, scenarios, implementations, warmups, and measured repetitions.
All eight headline co-primary superiority hypotheses reject their null and have lower simultaneous confidence bounds beyond their positive practical margins.
Every headline comparator-by-scenario co-primary contrast passes its non-inferiority guardrail.
The separately reported real-anatomy stratum passes every absolute, failure, and headline-comparator non-inferiority guardrail.
Every candidate accuracy, fidelity, and reliability guardrail passes its absolute and scenario-level non-inferiority rule.
The FSL MCFLIRT context family is reported in full, regardless of result.
The receipt contains no silent skip, retrospective margin, changed weight, or unregistered endpoint.

receipt.rawEvidenceRetention: Archive raw inputs or immutable source references, generated manifests, commands, stdout, stderr, all outputs, timing streams, checksums, analysis code, and the final signed receipt.

prohibitedEvidence: negated Euler columns as physical truth
a self-resampled image as the independent truth
voxels, landmarks, frames, or repetitions counted as independent subjects
native tSNR or DVARS treated as accuracy truth
retrospective endpoint, weight, sample, exclusion, or margin changes
a mixed speed-accuracy tradeoff described as joint superiority
an exploratory input with unknown provenance or license used in a claim
